annotations.title: Google Ads account users and invitations

description: Who can use a Google Ads account. action list (default): users with their role and user id, and email invitations with their status. invite: emailAddress + accessRole (ADMIN, STANDARD, READ_ONLY, EMAIL_ONLY); Google emails them; ADMIN needs confirm:true. revoke: withdraw a pending invitation (invitationId). set_role: change a user's accessRole (userId). remove: take a user's access away (userId). set_role and remove need confirm:true after the user agrees. Read back from Google. Free.

action.description: list (default), invite, revoke, set_role or remove

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits (dashes ok); omit for the brand's default account

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one
